Name: Fae's Elf Ears
Author: FaerieFangs0
Description:
Do you like cottage, fairy, or goblincore aesthetics? Well, at least I certainly do! I couldn't find a mod that added pointy ears to my character without messing with XNB files, so 20 tutorial tabs open (That isn't a joke) and a few hours later, I took a shot at making my own for Fashion Sense!

This mod adds a set of pointy ears under the hat section that should automatically match your farmer's skin tone! It should work with whatever body you're using. I've tested it some, but this is my first mod, so please let me know if there are any problems!

Requirements:
- Latest version of Content Patcher
- Latest Version of Fashion Sense
- Latest Version of SMAPI

Future Updates:
- More ear shapes?
- Refining!

Issues:
- Ears are functional with the male farmer sprite, but will have a small gap when viewed from the back with certain hair styles.
- May clip with other hats or some hair.

Installation: Unzip to your mod folder, or download with Vortex/any mod manager you like!
